vsk.name: Visakhapatnam
vsk.src: GVMC/Deccan Chronicle reports (capacities, levels mid-2026); demand 87 MGD

kak.name: Kakinada
kak.src: Godavari delta canals (Samalkot/Kakinada) and Yeleru system; no dedicated reservoir, so storage pool, supply and level are modelling assumptions; 108-135 LPCD municipal plan

vjw.name: Vijayawada
vjw.src: Prakasam Barrage capacity 3.07 TMC (press reports); run-of-river, fed from Pulichintala/Nagarjuna Sagar. Demand (~135 LPCD x population) and current level are assumptions

hyd.name: Hyderabad
hyd.src: Osman Sagar 3.90 + Himayat Sagar 2.97 TMC; HMWSSB supplies ~570 MGD mostly from Krishna, Godavari, Manjira. Demand and current level are estimates

maa.name: Chennai
maa.src: CMWSSB six-source capacities (13,222 mcft). Combined storage 44.31% (5,858 mcft) per a DT Next/WRD report on desilting; the report is undated, date inferred as mid-2026 pre-monsoon (Dec 2025 was 92.8%). Demand 2,232 MLD

blr.name: Bengaluru
blr.src: Cauvery allocation 24 TMC/yr (~1,460 MLD from KRS, 90 km away); demand ~2,632 MLD; groundwater ~800 MLD; 29% non-revenue water reported. Starting level 40.9% = KRS + Kabini combined (CWC weekly bulletin, 8 Oct 2026), a proxy for the allocation pool

status.storage: OFFICIAL (CWC 8 Oct 2026, KRS + Kabini proxy for allocation)

bom.name: Mumbai
bom.src: BMC bulletins, seven lakes 14,47,363 ML; 95.84% on 3 Oct 2026

del.name: Delhi
del.src: Delhi Jal Board production reports: ~950 MGD (about 4,300 MLD) supplied, Yamuna/Ganga/groundwater; Wazirabad pond is small, so storage pool, demand (~1,300 MGD) and level are assumptions
